title: Service Bus from C#
description: Use Azure Service Bus for enterprise messaging — queues, topics, and subscriptions from C#.

data.text: Azure Service Bus is a fully managed enterprise message broker. It supports **queues** (point-to-point) and **topics with subscriptions** (publish-subscribe), making it suitable for decoupling microservices, implementing the outbox pattern, and handling background workloads.

rows: One consumer per message, FIFO order
Ordered message groups per session ID

data.title: Install the Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus package
data.content:
// Package: Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus
dotnet add package Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus

data.text: Sending a Message to a Queue
Use ServiceBusSender to send messages to a queue or topic. Messages are JSON-serialized by default, and you can set properties like ContentType, Subject, and MessageId for tracking.

data.title: OrderQueueSender.cs — send order events to a Service Bus queue

data.text: Use ServiceBusProcessor for continuous message processing. The processor handles prefetching, concurrent calls, and automatic settlement (complete, abandon, dead-letter).

data.title: OrderProcessor.cs — process messages from a Service Bus queue
Always use explicit settlement
data.text: Keep AutoCompleteMessages = false. Complete, abandon, or dead-letter each message explicitly so you never lose a message due to an unhandled exception.

data.title: Send and process an order event
data.description: Build a sender and processor for an OrderCreated event using Service Bus.
steps: Provision a Service Bus namespace and queue in the Azure portal
Implement IOrderQueueSender and send a test event
Implement a hosted OrderProcessor that logs and fulfills the order
Send three events and confirm all three appear in the processor logs
data.expectedOutcome: Three OrderCreated messages are sent, processed, and completed in order.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use queues for one-way point-to-point messaging; topics for publish-subscribe
Use ServiceBusSender for sending; ServiceBusProcessor for continuous receiving
Set AutoCompleteMessages = false and settle messages explicitly
Dead-letter unprocessable messages; use ApplicationProperties for metadata routing
data.takeaway: Service Bus gives you reliable enterprise messaging with exactly-once delivery guarantees, dead-lettering, and sessions for ordered message groups.
